content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "Yes; the judge resolves the link as underdetermined by noting there is no explicit textual resolution of paternity, rather than weighing the chains by footing.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse: reading one, the judge must assess the full chains by their support and not demand an explicit contrary verse; reading two, the judge may find a link underdetermined because no explicit textual resolution appears.", "why": "The judge's reason for UNDERDETERMINED is the absence of explicit textual resolution of paternity, which K-C forbids as the retired stating-verse test and requires chain-by-footing weighing instead."}
